items.title: Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic just made a move on AI safety
Martin Casado on AI Safety: "Pacing" Is the Wrong Frame, and the Real Innovation Has Left the Labs
items.summary: The most dangerous thing an AI company can do right now is not train a smarter model. It is telling the world the technology might kill everyone, and then asking for more money to build it faster.

items.title: AI Safety or Market Control? Anthropic Investor Joe Lonsdale Takes Aim at Tech Giants
items.summary: An investor in Anthropic has accused leading artificial intelligence companies of pushing regulations that could concentrate power in their own hands, warning that concerns about the technology’s dangers must not give a handful of firms control over public policy.
